name: Kiara 4 Mid-Morning
md5Basis: matches the md5 published by api.polyhaven.com/files for hdri.2k.hdr
licenseBasis: All Poly Haven assets are published under CC0 (https://polyhaven.com/license).
captureLocationNote: Free State highveld, South Africa (rocky mountain valley). Not Jerusalem; chosen for a clear mid-morning sky with a low sun, matching the script's default morning sun preset.
downloadedWith: curl 8.18.0 (Git for Windows), verified with md5sum and sha256sum
intendedUse: Optional SkyLight cubemap (-UseHdri) for richer reflections on the gold veneer in /Game/MikdashV3/IntegratedReviewV2/Maps/Walkthrough. Off by default; SkyAtmosphere with real-time capture drives the sky.
creditLine: Sky reflections: 'Kiara 4 Mid-Morning' HDRI by Greg Zaal, Poly Haven, CC0 (attribution not required; given anyway). Add to Content/Distribution/CREDITS.txt only if the HDRI is adopted in a build.

alternativeConsidered.why_not: Clear midday desert sun (Namaqualand); a high sun contradicts the low-sun design and would double the highlight on the gold.
